subject: RiverMark: Service degradation — proposed remediation and contract amendment
messages:
From: Alexandra Chen <alex.chen@rivermark.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sudden throughput degradation impacting inference pipelines

Hi Marissa / Stephanie,

We saw a sustained degradation starting ~2026-11-08 22:30 UTC. Throughput dropped ~40% for our production ingest (batch scoring), and a subset of requests returned 5xx errors intermittently. Latency also spiked — 95th percentile went from ~320ms to ~1.2s. This has caused queueing in our downstream pipelines and put a couple of SLAs at risk.

We need an urgent explanation and (a) a timeline for resolution, (b) a remediation proposal, and (c) a statement on whether this incident will trigger commercial remediation under our contract. We’re pausing a portion of our scheduled release until this is resolved.

I’ve attached a short timeline and a sample of the logs we pulled from our side (incident_timeline_RiverMark_20261109.pdf, kv_cache_sample_logs_11-09.csv).

— Alex
Alexandra Chen
Head of Platform Engineering, RiverMark
alex.chen@rivermark.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Alexandra Chen <alex.chen@rivermark.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sudden throughput degradation impacting inference pipelines

Alex — thank you for the quick heads up and for the attachments. I’m really sorry you’re seeing this. We’re treating this as a priority incident.

What I can commit to right now:
- Immediate: I’ve opened an incident (RM-2026-11-09) with our SRE team and routed it to the highest priority. We’ve started a live root-cause investigation.
- Near term: I propose a 48-hour remediation plan (short-term scaling and config rollback options) and we’ll provide a rollback window if we find a config-induced regression.
- Commercial: we will quantify the scope and calculate potential SLA credits based on the contract. I’ll share an initial commercial estimate by EOD tomorrow after the investigation.

Can you share whether RiverMark intends to continue routing production traffic while we remediate, or would you like us to help you switch over to a mitigated path (lower throughput, isolated pool)? We can provision a temporary dedicated pool if you prefer.

Proposing a 30-minute exec sync today at 11:30 PT to align on mitigation and next steps. I’ll include Vivek and Ben on the call.

— Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: RiverMark incident — proposed remediation + commercial note

Team — forwarding RiverMark’s report. Key asks are timeline, remediation, and confirmation on SLA/credits. Initial thoughts:

1) Technical remediation (Ops) - SRE should look for the recent kernel selection change we rolled on 2026-11-07 (optimizations for long context) — matches timing. If that’s the regression, we can rollback and reprovision capacity within ~3–6 hours.

2) Short-term customer mitigation - Offer a temporary dedicated small pool (d-2) and route their highest-SLA routes to it. Estimate cost: ~2 days of reserved vCPU/GPU allocation; we take the infra hit.

3) Commercial framework - Recommend an interim goodwill credit: 10% of November hosting fees for observed window, with an option to formalize a contract amendment if customers request ongoing SLO guarantees. If root cause is our config/serving runtime regression, we should be prepared to offer a formal SLA credit calculation per contract Section 5.2.

4) Exec/Legal - If the customer requests a contract amendment/redline, loop in Legal early. Ben — can you prepare the first commercial note and a short summary for Vivek/Finance?

I’ll be on the 11:30 PT sync with the RiverMark team.

— Marissa

On Mon, Nov 9, 2026 at 09:05 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Alex — thank you for the quick heads up and for the attachments...
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: RiverMark incident — proposed remediation + commercial note

Marissa / team — quick commercial note ahead of the exec sync:

- If we confirm the regression was due to our kernel selection patch, my baseline recommendation is: 1) cover any overage costs from failed retries, 2) apply a credit equal to 15% of November’s hosting invoice for impacted routes, and 3) provide a 30% discount on their next 3 months of dedicated capacity should they accept a short-term dedicated pool (this mitigates churn risk).

- Legal has asked me to get a concrete list of impacted routes and the exact window (start/end). If we can ship that by EOD tomorrow, Legal will draft a short contract amendment (one-page) clarifying SLA measurement and the credit mechanics.

I’ll prepare two versions: Goodwill (non-contractual) and Formal Amendment (contractual). Vivek — want me to include an exec summary that quantifies ARR-at-risk and retention probability?

— Ben
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Alexandra Chen <alex.chen@rivermark.com>, Tim Low <tim.low@rivermark.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, legal@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: RiverMark remediation outcome and proposed contract amendment (attached)

Tim / Alex — thanks again for patience while we investigated. Short summary and proposed next steps: 

Summary of findings:
- Root cause: a kernel selection optimization we shipped on 2026-11-07 caused a regression for a specific attention pattern in RiverMark’s models, increasing tail latency and intermittent 5xxs for long-context batch scoring.
- Incident window: 2026-11-08T22:28:00Z to 2026-11-09T05:40:00Z (we have included the timestamps and per-route counts in the incident PDF).

Remediation performed:
- We rolled back the kernel selection patch at 02:10 UTC and applied a hotfix that prevented recurrence.
- We provisioned a temporary dedicated pool and migrated high-SLA routes. We’ll keep the pool for 72 hours unless you want an extended window.

Commercial proposal:
- Immediate goodwill credit: 12% of November hosting charges attributable to impacted routes (applied as an invoice credit).
- Formal amendment: attached is a redlined one-page contract amendment that defines SLA measurement windows, credit calculation, and an optional commitment for a dedicated pool with preferential pricing (redlined_contract_RiverMark_v2.docx). If Legal prefers, we can move to a DocuSign flow.

Attachments: incident_timeline_RiverMark_20261109.pdf, kv_cache_sample_logs_11-09.csv, redlined_contract_RiverMark_v2.docx

Please let me know if this is acceptable as a path forward. If so, Ben will shepherd the amendment and Legal will prepare the signature packet. Happy to jump on a follow-up call with Tim/Legal to walk through the redlines.

— Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Timothy Low <tim.low@rivermark.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Alexandra Chen <alex.chen@rivermark.com>, Legal <legal@rivermark.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 18:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RiverMark remediation outcome and proposed contract amendment (attached)

Marissa — thanks for the rapid investigation and the clear remediation steps. We appreciate the temporary pool and the rollback.

We’ve reviewed the proposed amendment and the 12% credit looks reasonable as an interim settlement. Legal has one small ask: make the SLA measurement window explicit (UTC boundaries) and add an audit clause to allow RiverMark to request logs for the impacted routes for 30 days post-incident. I see you CC’d Legal — they’ll coordinate directly with your Legal team.

Assuming we can resolve the two small legal items, RiverMark will accept the amendment and the credit. Please have Ben/Legal send the updated redline and DocuSign link.

— Tim
Chief Product Officer, RiverMark Analytics
